atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game prop texture atlas for twelve interactive chores in a traditional Malay village folklore mystery game. Generate ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024, arranged in a STRICT uniform 6 columns by 4 rows grid (24 equal 256x256 cells). Each prop centered inside its own cell with at least 24 pixels transparent padding, completely separate and never crossing cell boundaries. No grid lines, no labels, no words, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no scenery. Semi-realistic hand painted game art with detailed natural textures, warm soft directional light from top left, consistent three-quarter view, crisp readable silhouettes, weathered wood, stone, brass and terracotta. The objects should look tangible and realistic, not flat vector icons. Exact row-major contents:
Row 1: 1 an open blackened traditional rice cooking pot containing white rice; 2 a small woven bowl full of uncooked white rice; 3 a rustic blue ceramic water jug tilted slightly; 4 a bundle of three split firewood logs; 5 a piece of rough flint stone beside a small steel striker; 6 a traditional coconut-fibre broom with wooden handle diagonally oriented.
Row 2: 1 a crumpled folded red batik cloth; 2 a white jasmine flower with yellow center and two leaves; 3 a lush small cluster of green garden leaves; 4 a glossy blue glass marble; 5 an old brass oil lantern with glass chamber and warm flame; 6 a single brown traditional leather slipper seen from above.
Row 3: 1 a heavy gray stone mortar with NO pestle; 2 a separate long stone pestle diagonally oriented; 3 fresh ginger root with a sliced piece; 4 turmeric roots with orange cut ends; 5 a small cluster of fresh medicinal green herb leaves; 6 a weathered blue metal watering can with spout pointing right.
Row 4: 1 a terracotta pot with a healthy small green seedling; 2 a partially woven rectangular pandan mat viewed mostly from above; 3 a separate long horizontal green pandan leaf strip; 4 a rustic fishing net spread on wooden frame with visible knotted cord texture; 5 a loose coiled rope with one long free end; 6 a small irregular pile of dry leaves, dust and tiny twigs for sweeping.
Transparent background is essential, including gutters. No cast shadows outside each object's own cell; subtle contact shading within the prop is fine. All 24 objects must be clear, complete and neatly isolated for independent game sprites.

traditional_footwear:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a traditional Malay village game's shoe matching task. ONE square 1024x1024 PNG, exact 2 columns x 2 rows of 512x512 cells. In each cell show ONE SINGLE LEFT shoe, strict overhead top-down view, heel toward bottom and toe toward top, perfectly upright and centered. Each shoe stays entirely inside its own cell with minimum 64px transparent padding, including all straps and toe tips. Narrow vertically oriented silhouettes, approximately 220px wide by 370px tall, consistent scale. Genuine transparent alpha around each shoe, no background or cast shadow.
Top left: an old Malay wooden terompah clog, visibly carved thick natural wood sole and ONE broad BLUE dyed leather band across the instep, aged warm timber grain.
Top right: a traditional capal sandal, dark brown leather footbed with antique YELLOW/GOLD leather thong straps and toe post, visibly handmade, no modern branding.
Bottom left: an old traditional closed-toe embroidered court slipper, rich RED cloth upper with subtle gold embroidery, gently pointed toe and open heel, leather sole.
Bottom right: a traditional village sandal with GREEN woven pandan/rattan cross straps over a natural brown leather or woven footbed, simple handmade construction.
Style: semi-realistic hand painted game props with convincing wood grain, worn leather, embroidery, and woven fibre; soft neutral top-left illumination and crisp readable shapes. The blue, yellow, red and green identity of the four shoes must be obvious. The center of every shoe should be opaque material, not a transparent hole, for pointer selection. No sneakers, no laces, no sports shoes, no plastic flip-flops, no modern rubber sole, no logos, no text, no feet, no people, no pairs, no extra shoes, no border or grid lines. Only these four isolated shoes.
